# ankra_alert_routes (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's notification routing rules in evaluation order. The counterpart of `ankra alerts routes list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_alert_routes" "all" {}

output "route_count" {
  value = length(data.ankra_alert_routes.all.routes)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Routes, by ascending priority. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `application_id` (String) Application matched.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster matched.
- `destination_id` (String) Destination id, or `push:<audience>`.
- `destination_type` (String) `webhook` or `push`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is evaluated.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the route.
- `kind` (String) Legacy single-kind filter.
- `kinds` (List of String) Kinds matched; null matches every kind.
- `kinds_negated` (Boolean) Whether the route matches every kind except `kinds`.
- `mode` (String) `include` or `exclude`.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order.
- `reference_pattern` (String) Reference glob matched.
- `severity` (String) Severity matched.
- `source_id` (String) Source matched.
- `stop_on_match` (Boolean) Whether a match ends the walk.
